# `math` standard library

The `math` module exposes C99 `libm` mathematical functions for 64-bit IEEE 754
`Float` values, along with standard mathematical constants. Importing `math`
automatically links `-lm`.

```{.dva .run}
#use math
```

## Constants

| Constant | Type | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `math::pi` | `Float` | `3.14159265358979323846` | Archimedes' constant $\pi$ |
| `math::e` | `Float` | `2.71828182845904523536` | Euler's number $e$ |

## Function catalog

### Roots and powers

| Function | Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| `math::sqrt(x)` | `Float => Float` | Square root $\sqrt{x}$ | `math::sqrt(16.0)` $\rightarrow$ `4.0` |
| `math::cbrt(x)` | `Float => Float` | Cube root $\sqrt[3]{x}$ | `math::cbrt(27.0)` $\rightarrow$ `3.0` |
| `math::hypot(x, y)` | `Float, Float => Float` | Hypotenuse $\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}$ | `math::hypot(3.0, 4.0)` $\rightarrow$ `5.0` |
| `math::pow(x, y)` | `Float, Float => Float` | Power $x^y$ | `math::pow(2.0, 8.0)` $\rightarrow$ `256.0` |

### Exponentials and logarithms

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `math::exp(x)` | `Float => Float` | Natural exponential $e^x$ |
| `math::exp2(x)` | `Float => Float` | Base-2 exponential $2^x$ |
| `math::expm1(x)` | `Float => Float` | $e^x - 1$ (accurate for small $x$) |
| `math::log(x)` | `Float => Float` | Natural logarithm $\ln(x)$ |
| `math::log2(x)` | `Float => Float` | Binary logarithm $\log_2(x)$ |
| `math::log10(x)` | `Float => Float` | Common logarithm $\log_{10}(x)$ |
| `math::log1p(x)` | `Float => Float` | $\ln(1 + x)$ (accurate for small $x$) |

### Trigonometry and hyperbolics

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `math::sin(x)`, `math::cos(x)`, `math::tan(x)` | `Float => Float` | Sine, cosine, tangent (radians) |
| `math::asin(x)`, `math::acos(x)`, `math::atan(x)` | `Float => Float` | Inverse circular functions |
| `math::atan2(y, x)` | `Float, Float => Float` | Multi-quadrant inverse tangent |
| `math::sinh(x)`, `math::cosh(x)`, `math::tanh(x)` | `Float => Float` | Hyperbolic sine, cosine, tangent |
| `math::asinh(x)`, `math::acosh(x)`, `math::atanh(x)` | `Float => Float` | Inverse hyperbolic functions |

### Rounding and floating-point manipulation

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `math::floor(x)` | `Float => Float` | Largest integer not greater than $x$ |
| `math::ceil(x)` | `Float => Float` | Smallest integer not less than $x$ |
| `math::rint(x)` | `Float => Float` | Round to nearest integer using current rounding mode |
| `math::fabs(x)` | `Float => Float` | Absolute value of $x$ |
| `math::fmod(x, y)` | `Float, Float => Float` | Floating-point remainder of $x / y$ |
| `math::fmin(x, y)` | `Float, Float => Float` | Minimum of $x$ and $y$ |
| `math::fmax(x, y)` | `Float, Float => Float` | Maximum of $x$ and $y$ |
| `math::ldexp(x, exp)` | `Float, i32 => Float` | $x \times 2^{\text{exp}}$ |

*(Note: Truncation, round-to-nearest, and copysign are provided by built-in LLVM intrinsics: `%trunc(x)`, `%round(x)`, and `%copysign(x, y)`).*

## Submodules

### `math/geom` — 2D and 3D Euclidean geometry

Import with `#use math/geom`. Operates on homogeneous float tuples leveraging hardware vector and SIMD intrinsics.

| Export | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Vec2` | `(Float, Float)` | 2D vector / coordinate tuple |
| `Vec3` | `(Float, Float, Float)` | 3D vector tuple |
| `Vec4` | `(Float, Float, Float, Float)` | 4D vector / homogeneous coordinate tuple |
| `Point2` | `(Float, Float)` | 2D point alias |
| `Rect` | `(Float, Float, Float, Float)` | 2D axis-aligned rectangle `(x, y, w, h)` |
| `geom::vec2` | `Float, Float => Vec2` | 2D vector constructor |
| `geom::vec3` | `Float, Float, Float => Vec3` | 3D vector constructor |
| `geom::vec4` | `Float, Float, Float, Float => Vec4` | 4D vector constructor |
| `geom::rect` | `Float, Float, Float, Float => Rect` | Rectangle constructor |
| `geom::dot` | `Vec2, Vec2 => Float` | 2D dot product via `%dot` |
| `geom::len` | `Vec2 => Float` | 2D vector Euclidean magnitude |
| `geom::dist` | `Vec2, Vec2 => Float` | 2D Euclidean distance between vectors |
| `geom::dist_sq` | `Vec2, Vec2 => Float` | Squared 2D Euclidean distance |
| `geom::norm` | `Vec2 => Vec2` | Unit normalized 2D vector (returns `(0.0, 0.0)` if `len < 1e-9`) |
| `geom::lerp` | `Vec2, Vec2, Float => Vec2` | Linear interpolation `a + (b - a) * t` via `%fmuladd` |
| `geom::angle` | `Vec2 => Float` | Direction angle in radians via `atan2` |
| `geom::angle_deg` | `Vec2 => Float` | Direction angle in degrees normalized to `[0, 360)` |
| `geom::rotate` | `Vec2, Float => Vec2` | Rotates vector counterclockwise by angle in radians |
| `geom::dot3` | `Vec3, Vec3 => Float` | 3D dot product |
| `geom::len3` | `Vec3 => Float` | 3D vector Euclidean magnitude |
| `geom::dist3` | `Vec3, Vec3 => Float` | 3D Euclidean distance |
| `geom::norm3` | `Vec3 => Vec3` | Unit normalized 3D vector |
| `geom::cross3` | `Vec3, Vec3 => Vec3` | 3D vector cross product |
| `geom::rect_contains` | `Rect, Point2 => <>` | Tests whether point `(px, py)` lies inside rectangle |
| `geom::circle_contains` | `Point2, Float, Point2 => <>` | Tests whether point lies within circle `(center, radius)` |
| `geom::rect_union` | `Rect, Rect => Rect` | Bounding rectangle enclosing both rectangles |
| `geom::rect_intersect` | `Rect, Rect => Rect` | Overlapping region of two rectangles |

```{.dva .run}
#use io
#use math/geom

v = geom::vec2(3.0, 4.0)
io::out(geom::len(v))
// => 5
```

### `math/complex` — Complex numbers and FFT

Import with `#use math/complex`. Provides Cartesian and polar complex arithmetic and hardware-accelerated Cooley-Tukey Radix-2 FFT.

| Export | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Complex` | `(re: Float, im: Float)` | Complex number record with real and imaginary parts |
| `complex::make` | `Float, Float => Complex` | Constructs complex number `re + im * i` |
| `complex::from_real` | `Float => Complex` | Real scalar embed `r + 0i` |
| `complex::zero!` | `() => Complex` | Additive identity `0 + 0i` |
| `complex::one!` | `() => Complex` | Multiplicative identity `1 + 0i` |
| `complex::i!` | `() => Complex` | Imaginary unit `0 + 1i` |
| `complex::real` | `Complex => Float` | Extracts real component `.re` |
| `complex::imag` | `Complex => Float` | Extracts imaginary component `.im` |
| `complex::add` | `Complex, Complex => Complex` | Complex addition `(a + b)` |
| `complex::sub` | `Complex, Complex => Complex` | Complex subtraction `(a - b)` |
| `complex::mul` | `Complex, Complex => Complex` | Complex multiplication via fused `%fma` |
| `complex::scale` | `Complex, Float => Complex` | Multiplies complex number by real scalar |
| `complex::conj` | `Complex => Complex` | Complex conjugate `re - im * i` |
| `complex::norm_sq` | `Complex => Float` | Squared magnitude `re^2 + im^2` |
| `complex::abs` | `Complex => Float` | Modulus / magnitude $\sqrt{\text{re}^2 + \text{im}^2}$ |
| `complex::arg` | `Complex => Float` | Principal phase angle in radians $(-\pi, \pi]$ |
| `complex::polar` | `Float, Float => Complex` | Constructs from polar coordinates `(r, theta)` |
| `complex::exp` | `Complex => Complex` | Complex exponential $e^z = e^{\text{re}}(\cos(\text{im}) + i\sin(\text{im}))$ |
| `complex::fft` | `ComplexArray => ComplexArray` | Cooley-Tukey Radix-2 forward FFT ($N = 2^k$) |
| `complex::ifft` | `ComplexArray => ComplexArray` | Inverse FFT normalized by $1/N$ |

```{.dva .run}
#use io
#use math/complex

z1 = complex::make(1.0, 2.0)
z2 = complex::make(3.0, 4.0)
prod = complex::mul(z1, z2)
io::out((complex::real(prod), complex::imag(prod)))
// => -5 10
```
